svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame: print flat in ASA, 110 x 90 x 3 mm with an 88 x 68 mm opening

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and four 3.4 mm holes, 47 and 37 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Film: cut 100 x 80 mm from 0.5 mm unpigmented HDPE with a sharp

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: knife on glass; do not touch the middle with bare fingers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use the frame as a template: punch four 3.5 mm holes in the film.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: film on the housing ledge, frame over it, four M3 screws into

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the heat-set inserts, tightened evenly until the film is flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The array looks through the 88 x 68 mm opening; the field of view

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: needs only about 30 x 20 mm of it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the film is flat and taut with no creases in the opening.
